# Fixtures

Spec: `docs/design/spec/16-test-plan.md`, section 1. Each fixture is `tree/` + `build.sh TARGET`
(deterministic git history). No real history is ever copied.

| Fixture | Built by | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `fx-split-stack` | hand-written `tree/` + `history.tsv` (one line per branch: name, subject, files added) + `build.sh TARGET` | built (spec 16, section 2.1; checked by A0.1 and A0.2) |
| `fx-hostile` | hand-written `tree/` (invalid `.claude/settings.json`, bidirectional Unicode in a fiche) + `build.sh TARGET`, which creates the untracked names git cannot hold (folder with a newline and ESC holding a `.env`, outbound links, a `..` link) | built (R3, A14.23) |
| `fx-ci-github`, `fx-ci-gitlab` | hand-written files, one per case of A14.9, no `build.sh`: the test copies one case into a temporary repository (see each README) | built (R3, A14.9) |
| `fx-large` | generated by `tests/fxlarge.py` (A1.7, A14.10) | built (R3) |
| `fx-laravel`, `fx-vue`, `fx-nestjs`, `fx-python`, `fx-monorepo`, `fx-new`, `fx-conflict`, `fx-rich-claude-md` | hand-written `tree/` + `build.sh` | phase P1 |
